description: A five-item, five-point anchored observational assessment tool created by Nilsson and colleagues to rate laparoscopic camera-navigation skills in surgical novices during operating-room procedures.
title: OSA-CNS assessment tool for camera navigation skills in the operating room

description: A 12-item, five-point global-rating assessment chart developed by the study authors to evaluate physician-staffed prehospital personnel's technical performance of resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA).
title: OSAPRA: an objective structured assessment chart for prehospital REBOA performance

description: A structured rubric for assessing ophthalmology residents’ competence in routine penetrating keratoplasty, developed by cornea specialists and approved by the Ophthalmology Foundation.
title: OSCAR for PK

description: A structured ophthalmic surgical-skills assessment rubric that combines procedure-specific steps with global competency indices and four-level descriptors for rating residents and guiding progression.
title: OSCAR surgical competency rubric

description: A researcher-developed OSCE instrument using five timed clinical scenarios and checklist scoring to assess midwives' clinical skills in substance-dependent maternity care.
title: OSCE instrument with five clinical scenarios assessing midwives' skills in substance-dependent maternity care

description: OSCEai is a web-based application developed by Guo Eddie et al.
title: OSCEai

description: OSCRS is a VR-, AI-, and haptic-enabled dental clinical-reasoning training and assessment platform developed by Beijing Unidraw Virtual Reality Technology Institute Co., Ltd.
title: OSCRS (Oral Scenario-Based Clinical Reasoning Training and Assessment System)

description: An OSF-hosted replication package from Zambrano et al.
title: OSF repository

description: Osmosis is a commercial web-based medical learning platform offering audiovisual videos, flashcards, clinical decision-making trees, concept-focused notes, embedded case-based quizzes, and administrator usage dashboards.
title: Osmosis

description: OSSCAR is a 16-step, three-level rubric adapted from the ICO-OSCAR for grading ophthalmology residents' phacoemulsification performance in wet-lab simulation videos.
title: OSSCAR (Ophthalmic Simulated Surgical Competency Assessment Rubric)
